test_modes.name: Bus monitor / analyzer
test_modes.purpose: Capture and decode telegrams (SD1-SD4) on the wire for protocol debug.

test_modes.name: Live List scan
test_modes.purpose: Enumerate present stations and their FDL state.

test_modes.name: Diagnostic polling
test_modes.purpose: Repeatedly Get_Diag a slave to track station/module/channel faults.

spec_provided_observability.name: Slave_Diag (Get_Diag)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reads layered slave diagnostics: station status 1/2/3, master address, Ident_Number, module and channel diagnostics.

spec_provided_observability.name: FDL status request (SD1)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Queries a station's FDL state (e.g. ready to enter the ring / slave).

spec_provided_observability.name: Get_Configuration
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reads back the slave's current module configuration.

spec_provided_observability.name: Live List / GAP maintenance
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observes which stations are present on the bus.

spec_provided_observability.name: FCS / response status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Telegram checksum pass/fail and presence/absence of the expected response.

error_detection_mechanisms: 8-bit FCS checksum per data/fixed telegram detects corruption.
Frame Count Bit (FCB/FCV) detects duplicate or lost telegrams.
Slot-time (TSL) timeout detects a missing response.
Watchdog timeout detects loss of cyclic master access at the slave.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A slave flags it; the master re-reads the full diagnostic telegram.
Process / diagnostic / pull-plug / status / update alarm (acknowledged).
No response within the slot time (TSL).
Loss of cyclic access at the slave.

notes: PROFIBUS exposes its protocol-level test/debug surface through Slave_Diag (layered diagnostics), the FDL status request, Get_Configuration, the Live List, per-telegram FCS/parity, and the MAC timers. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain controller-vendor / SoC concerns.
